# afs/ (Annual Financial Statements engine)

Full AFS lifecycle: draft → review → partner_review → signed_off → filed. Shipped Apr 2026 (8 phases; migrations 333-345). Covers both `afs` and `management_pack` document types.

## Endpoints

### Document CRUD + config
- `GET|POST /api/accounting/afs` — list / create document; body `{ fiscalYear?, period?, documentType, reportingFramework }`
- `GET /api/accounting/afs/[documentId]` — document + sections
- `GET /api/accounting/afs/report-templates` — rendered template (`?type=compilation|accounting_officer|review|audit&entity_type=pty|cc|trust&framework=ifrs_smes|full_ifrs`)
- `GET|PUT /api/accounting/afs/brand-profile` — firm branding used in PDF
- `GET|PUT /api/accounting/afs/management-pack-config` — auto-pack scheduler settings
- `GET /api/accounting/afs/entity-terminology` — terminology map + disclosure requirements
- `GET|POST /api/accounting/afs/images` — list / upload brand images; `DELETE /api/accounting/afs/images/[imageId]`
- `GET|POST /api/accounting/afs/portal-contacts` — directors/CFOs; `PUT|DELETE /api/accounting/afs/portal-contacts/[contactId]`

### Generation / review / signing
- `POST /api/accounting/afs/[documentId]/generate` — enqueue render job (blocked on `signed_off`/`filed`)
- `POST /api/accounting/afs/[documentId]/submit-for-review` — → `in_review`
- `POST /api/accounting/afs/[documentId]/sign-off` — partner sign-off (CONFLICT on bad state)
- `POST /api/accounting/afs/[documentId]/send-for-signing` — Signum flow; body `{ signerContactIds }`; requires `partner_review`
- `POST /api/accounting/afs/[documentId]/compliance-check` — IFRS compliance rules
- `GET /api/accounting/afs/[documentId]/export?format=pdf|docx|caseware` — streams binary or manifest
- `GET /api/accounting/afs/[documentId]/proof-copy` — rendered proof HTML
- `GET /api/accounting/afs/[documentId]/proof-copy-checklist` — pre-send checklist
- `GET /api/accounting/afs/[documentId]/cipc-filing-guide` — deadline + forms + checklist
- `GET /api/accounting/afs/[documentId]/pis-score` — Public Interest Score from live GL

### Sections
- `PUT /api/accounting/afs/[documentId]/sections/reorder`
- `PUT /api/accounting/afs/[documentId]/sections/[sectionId]/overrides` — snapshots current version before apply
- `GET|POST /api/accounting/afs/[documentId]/sections/[sectionId]/versions` — history + restore
- `POST /api/accounting/afs/[documentId]/sections/[sectionId]/regenerate|suppress|review|sign-off|ai-narrative`
- `GET|POST /api/accounting/afs/[documentId]/sections/[sectionId]/comments` + `POST /comments/[commentId]/resolve`

### Cash-flow / equity statements
- `GET /api/accounting/afs/[documentId]/statements/cash-flow-direct`
- `GET /api/accounting/afs/[documentId]/statements/cash-flow-reconciliation`
- `GET /api/accounting/afs/[documentId]/statements/changes-in-equity`

### Company-level PIS
- `GET|PUT /api/accounting/afs/pis-score` — standalone compute (`?fiscal_year=`) / update PIS inputs

### Management packs
- `GET /api/accounting/afs/management-packs` — list
- `GET /api/accounting/afs/management-packs/[packId]` — detail (IDOR-guarded)
- `POST /api/accounting/afs/management-packs/[packId]/deliver` — send to contacts
- `POST /api/accounting/afs/generate-pack` — body `{ period: 'YYYY-MM' }`; throws `DuplicatePackError`

### Cron
- `POST /api/accounting/afs/cron/management-packs` — 06:00 SAST, header `X-Cron-Secret` = `CRON_SECRET`

## Auth
`withAuth(withErrorHandler(handler as never))` staff-only on all user routes. Cron route bypasses `withAuth` and verifies `X-Cron-Secret`. Export streams raw binary — do NOT unwrap `json.data`.

## Business rules
- `documentType: afs|management_pack`; `reportingFramework: ifrs_smes|full_ifrs`
- `generate` is async — enqueued via `afsGenerationJobService`; poll separately
- `send-for-signing` reads rendered HTML from `afsStorage.afsHtmlPath()`; 400 if not yet generated; signer contacts must be `director` or `cfo`
- Section override PUT snapshots version before apply
- While `signing_requested_at` is set the document takes NO section write (409) — the signatories are signing the content as it stands. The Signum webhook signs off only from `partner_review` and only while the content fingerprint recorded at send still holds; otherwise it records `signing_refused_reason` and hands the document back. `send-for-signing` needs every mandatory section signed off (409).
- `generate-pack` with `reviewRequired: false` is refused (409) until a published status exists.
- Section writes (overrides, versions POST, ai-narrative POST/PUT, regenerate, suppress, reorder, comments) are bound to the URL's `documentId`: a section of another document is 404, a signed-off/filed document is 409 `CONFLICT`. Overrides, AI accept, restore, regenerate and suppress void the section's review (→ pending, reviewer/signatory cleared, `audit_log` row).
- `export?format=caseware` returns manifest (names + sizes), not raw binaries
- PIS flags `dataUnavailable` for stubbed input fields
- `ReviewError` → HTTP 409 `CONFLICT`
